subject.title: [Refactor] Extract CLI flag parsing into type-safe schema validators

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a cross-cutting CLI schema/parser migration, or require a narrow demonstrated parsing defect before accepting refactor work?
rationale: The report requests an architectural direction rather than fixing a documented broken CLI contract, and its named implementation paths are not current-main grounded.

options.title: Require a narrow proposal
options.body: Ask for one current CLI command family, the duplicated invariant it violates, and compatibility proof before considering a focused refactor.

options.title: Sponsor a CLI architecture RFC
options.body: Assign an owner to define the shared parser contract, public CLI compatibility policy, migration sequence, and validation plan before implementation.

recommendation.title: Require a narrow proposal
recommendation.body: Ask for one current CLI command family, the duplicated invariant it violates, and compatibility proof before considering a focused refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md ownership and the cross-cutting architectural nature make this the best available routing candidate.
